Identify the compound subjects or the compound predicates in the following simple sentences.

i) The manager and his secretary went out to lunch.

ii) The manager finished his ice-cream and ordered for a coffee.

iii) Hasan, Karim and Shahana will go on the field trip with us.

iv) Jogging, swimming, and cycling are good exercises.

v) Jogging strengthens the heart and lungs but is hard on the knees and ankles.

Make sentences by adding compound subjects to these predicates.

i) ____________________ are competing in the race.

ii) ____________________ make good pets.

iii) ____________________ went to Bhutan on holidays last week.

iv) On Shihab's study table ____________________ were piled.

v) ____________________ amused the audience at the circus thoroughly.

Make sentences by adding compound predicates to the following subjects.

i) At the Trade Fair we ____________________.

ii) The doctor ____________________.

iii) The singer ____________________.

iv) Last week some of my friends ____________________.

v) Jack and Jill ____________________.
